brief: a 15 second ad for our cold brew coffee can, for Instagram

context.audience: urban 22-35 year olds who need a lift at 3 pm

concept: The 3 pm slump breaks the moment the can cracks open: one sound, one sip, the afternoon switches back on.
plan_outline: 1. ECU · eye · static · office desk, grey afternoon light · a finger pulls the can's tab, condensation beads on the metal (2 s, the hook: sound and texture)
2. MCU · eye · push in · same desk · a tired young man in a grey hoodie takes the first sip, eyes closed (3 s)
3. CU · low · static · same desk · the can set down hard; light through the window turns warm and bright (2 s, the turn)
4. MS · eye · track · open-plan office · he walks fast between desks, the can in hand, colleagues glance up (4 s)
5. Hero · eye · orbit · dark ground, rim light · the can alone, drops running down, slow orbit (3 s)
6. End card (page) · logo, 'Cold brew. 3 pm fixed.' (2 s)
why: Problem → solution in 15 s: the slump is a feeling everyone knows, shown in two seconds, not explained.
The hook is sound and texture (the tab crack, condensation) in a macro: it stops the scroll with the sound off too.
Light carries the turn: grey and flat before the sip, warm after — the change is the product's promise without a claim.
Hands stay simple (one finger on a tab, a hand around a can); no fiddly hand work for the model.
The line goes on a designed end card, never as words the video model draws.
